notes_md:
### Added

- **Big picture on the desk display.** Tap a provider for a large percentage
  dial and an explicit under/over pace reading. On the 1.8-inch rectangle,
  reset time sits beside the dial at nearly the same size. Time rounds to
  hours, with minutes during the last hour; exhausted windows take priority.
  Tap again for charts, or hold / press PWR to return home.

### Changed

- **Settings uses the house settings window.** Headroom's Mac Settings now
  runs on HouseKit's shared shell, the same window Sift uses. Every pane and
  integration page is where it was. General shows Launch at login and
  Updates first, then the time zone and the welcome window. Some labels take
  the house words, for example "This version" for "Current". The iPhone app
  does not change.
